thread:
ryan: bringing up kumo21b (21B, int4) on green cluster. getting sporadic OOMs under mixed chat+summary load. seems correlated with large batch of streaming responses + a few 3xx-token completions in the same microbatch. anyone seen slotmap fragmentation behave like this?

marta: saw something similar with a 21b earlier this month. slot_map free_chunks would be noncontiguous after repeated prefetched kv inserts, causing small allocations to fail despite headroom. logs?

ryan: pasted relevant node log:```
[2025-12-02T09:34:12Z] ALLOC_FAIL: cannot allocate 49152 bytes at slot_map.cpp:221
stack: slot::alloc -> prefetch_manager::expand_window -> runtime::handle_stream -> model::generate
mem_free=1.8GB mem_total=64GB free_chunks=47 largest_contig=0.9MB kv_slots_alloc=1450
```

lee: ugh contiguous gap < page_size is killer. two levers we tried: compact-on-evict (coalesce adjacent free slots during eviction) and soft-reserve (reserve N pages per long-gen request). both reduce OOMs but have tradeoffs (write stalls, slightly higher p99).

tara: for kumo canary i propose a 3-prong immediate mitigation: (A) lower default max_new_tokens to 320 for kumo (from 512), (B) enable compact-on-evict in runtime for canary only, (C) enable adaptive microbatching: if any request in batch requests >300 tokens, reduce microbatch cap to 4.

ryan: sample rollout override i put together:```json
{"model":"kumo21b","overrides":{"defaults":{"max_new_tokens":320},"runtime_flags":{"compact_on_evict":true,"adaptive_microbatch_threshold":300,"microbatch_cap":4}}}
```
apply to 15% canary.

marta: quick thought — compact_on_evict will incur more CPU on eviction. we should gate it by evict_watermark so it's only active when free_chunks < 100. otherwise unnecessary churn.

lee: agreed. also add a guard in prefetch: estimate_new_slots = ceil(max_new_tokens / tokens_per_slot). if estimate_new_slots > 40, skip prefetch and mark request as long-gen. simple heuristic reduces frag significantly in our repro.

ryan: ran a short repro (50 runs): baseline canary w/ prefetched long gens: 12 OOMs/50. with adaptive_microbatch + compact-on-evict (evict_watermark=100) we saw 1 OOM/50 and p99 latency +210ms on long gens only. short gens unaffected.

tara: we need to check quality impact of dropping default from 512->320. can someone run eval against our QA set (50 queries) and compute exact-match/F1 and BLEU? put seeds so runs are deterministic.

marta: i'll run a paired evaluation: kumo int4 512 vs kumo int4 320 vs kumo fp16 512 (control) using the same prompt set and seed 42. i'll share diffs in ~30m. also flagging any hallucination uptick.

ci-bot: PR #4318 opened: kumo21b per-model overrides + compact_on_evict flag + prefetch heuristic. CI green.

lee: ops note: i'll add metric slot_largest_contiguous and free_chunk_count to the model dashboard and create alert: free_chunk_count drops >50% in 10m OR slot_largest_contiguous < 1MB -> page_team pager.

ryan: thanks. followups: marta (eval + diff), lee (dashboard + alert), tara (deploy canary config), ryan (monitor canary & collect heap snapshots). reconvene in 45m. :raised_hands:
